test_title: PYST 45: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 06 Mar, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: There are many cases in which, by deviating from the strictly ethic code, you do not harm anyone, you only injure your own soul.
There are many cases in which, by diviating from the strictly ethic code, you do not harm anyone, you only injure your own soul.
There are many cases in which, by deviating from the strictly ethec code, you do not harm anyone, you only injure your own soul.
There are many cases in which, by deviating from the strictly ethic code, you do not harm anyone, you only injure your own soule.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"deviating"** means departing from an established course or norm. (विचलित होना)

 
 
• **Example: **He was **deviating **from the usual path to explore new possibilities.
 
 
 
• **"Ethic"** refers to a set of moral principles that govern a person's behavior or conducting an activity. (नैतिक)
 
 
• **Example: **Her strong work** ethic **earned her the respect of her colleagues.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** "Diviating" is a misspelling of "deviating". (विचलित होना)

 
 
• **Example:** He was diviating from the plan, which caused confusion. (Incorrect spelling)
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Ethec" is a misspelling of "ethic". (नैतिक)
 
 
• **Example:** She always follows a strict ethec code. (Incorrect spelling)
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "Soule" is a misspelling of "soul". (आत्मा)
 
 
• **Example:** He felt the injuries deep in his soule. (Incorrect spelling)
 
 

32:Tc9b,

The correct answer is: **Option 3.**
